items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The incident that I knew about was when Jamie Whitten called

ctx.x: She got in touch with a Congressman... I don’t know what that was about. She wrote a column for the newspaper, and he took exception to something that she wrote, and she called him about it.

The incident that I knew about was when Jamie Whitten called, because she had written something in her column. She said, “I can’t talk right now, because it’s me to go,” which meant it was her to play the hand.
So she was an avid bridge player also.
